ex.en: I got a good grade in English.
ex.zh: 我英文成績很好。

ex.en: I made efforts to improve my grades.
ex.zh: 我努力提高成績。

ex.en: I got terrible grades this term.
ex.zh: 我這個學期的成績很差。

grade.en: a mark that shows how well you did in school

ex.en: My son is in the third grade.
ex.zh: 我兒子讀三年級。

ex.en: She skipped a grade because she was so smart.
ex.zh: 她因為太聰明而跳了一級。

grade.en: a school year in the United States

ex.en: The teacher is grading our essays this weekend.
ex.zh: 老師這個週末在改我們的作文。

ex.en: Eggs are graded by size.
ex.zh: 雞蛋依大小分級。

grade.en: to give a mark to a student's work

ex.en: She was only 18 when she graduated from university.
ex.zh: 她十八歲就大學畢業了。

ex.en: I've got a feeling that Tom won't graduate this year.
ex.zh: 我覺得湯姆今年畢不了業。

ex.en: He went back to the village after he graduated.
ex.zh: 他畢業後回到了鄉下。

graduate.en: to finish your studies at a school or university

ex.en: The principal presented each of the graduates with diploma.
ex.zh: 校長頒發畢業證書給每一位畢業生。

ex.en: She is a graduate of National Taiwan University.
ex.zh: 她是台灣大學的畢業生。

graduate.en: a person who has finished studying at a school or university

ex.en: He is a graduate student in physics.
ex.zh: 他是物理研究所的學生。

ex.en: Graduate school is more focused on research.
ex.zh: 研究所更注重研究。

graduate.en: relating to studies done after a first university degree

grocery.zh: 食品雜貨店（常用 grocery store）

ex.en: Please tell us where there is a grocery store.
ex.zh: 請告訴我們哪裡有雜貨店。

ex.en: Please buy some blood oranges at the grocery store.
ex.zh: 請在雜貨店買一些血橙。

ex.en: Bob worked as a clerk in the grocery store on Saturday.
ex.zh: 鮑伯星期六在雜貨店當店員。

grocery.en: a shop that sells food and things for the home

ex.en: I need to buy some groceries after work.
ex.zh: 我下班後要去買些日常用品和食物。

ex.en: Can you help me carry the groceries?
ex.zh: 你可以幫我提這些買來的東西嗎？

grocery.en: food and other things bought regularly for the home

graphic.zh: 圖像的、圖形的；平面設計的

ex.en: There were some graphic novels mixed into the pile of specialty books on the desk.
ex.zh: 桌上那疊專業書裡混了幾本圖像小說。

ex.en: She works as a graphic designer.
ex.zh: 她是一名平面設計師。

graphic.en: relating to pictures, drawings or visual design

ex.en: He gave a graphic description of the accident.
ex.zh: 他生動地描述了那場意外。

ex.en: The report gave a graphic account of the working conditions.
ex.zh: 這份報告詳盡地描述了工作環境。

graphic.en: described in clear and shocking detail

graphic.zh: 圖形、圖像（常用複數 graphics）

ex.en: The game has amazing graphics.
ex.zh: 這款遊戲的畫面很驚人。

ex.en: Add some graphics to make the slides clearer.
ex.zh: 加一些圖像讓投影片更清楚。

graphic.en: a picture or image made on a computer

ex.en: Although his exam scores weren't very high, he was still successful after graduation.
ex.zh: 雖然他考試成績不高，畢業後還是很成功。

ex.en: What are your plans after graduation?
ex.zh: 你畢業後有什麼打算？

ex.en: My parents came to my graduation ceremony.
ex.zh: 我爸媽來參加了我的畢業典禮。

graduation.en: the act of finishing school, or the ceremony for it

ex.en: The game has amazing graphics.
ex.zh: 這款遊戲的畫面很驚人。

ex.en: She designs graphics for websites.
ex.zh: 她替網站設計圖像。

ex.en: This laptop has a powerful graphics card.
ex.zh: 這台筆電有很強的顯示卡。

graphics.en: pictures and images made on a computer, or visual design

ex.en: I like eating grilled lamb skewers.
ex.zh: 我喜歡吃烤羊肉串。

ex.en: Dad grilled some fish for dinner.
ex.zh: 爸爸晚餐烤了一些魚。

grill.en: to cook food over direct heat

ex.en: Put the steaks on the grill.
ex.zh: 把牛排放到烤架上。

ex.en: We cleaned the grill after the party.
ex.zh: 派對結束後我們把烤架清乾淨。

grill.en: a metal frame or machine for cooking food over heat

ex.en: Reporters grilled the minister about the scandal.
ex.zh: 記者針對醜聞追問部長。

ex.en: My parents grilled me about where I'd been.
ex.zh: 我爸媽一直追問我去了哪裡。

grill.en: to ask someone many hard questions for a long time

ex.en: A bowl of rice weighs about 180 grams.
ex.zh: 一碗飯大約重 180 公克。

ex.en: This chocolate bar contains 20 grams of sugar.
ex.zh: 這條巧克力含有 20 公克的糖。

gram.en: a unit of weight, one thousandth of a kilogram

ex.en: The company's gross profit rose by 8 percent.
ex.zh: 公司的毛利成長了百分之八。

ex.en: My gross salary is higher than my take-home pay.
ex.zh: 我的稅前薪資比實領薪資高。

gross.en: total, before anything has been taken away

ex.en: The movie grossed over 100 million dollars.
ex.zh: 這部電影票房超過一億美元。

ex.en: The film grossed 20 million in its first week.
ex.zh: 這部片上映首週票房達兩千萬。

gross.en: to earn a total amount of money before costs

ex.en: He is gross, man!
ex.zh: 他很噁心耶！

ex.en: Ew, that's gross!
ex.zh: 噁，好噁心！

gross.en: very unpleasant and making you feel sick

ex.en: Keep a firm grip on the rope.
ex.zh: 緊緊抓住繩子。

ex.en: These tires have a good grip on wet roads.
ex.zh: 這款輪胎在濕滑路面抓地力很好。

ex.en: I'm losing my grip.
ex.zh: 我快要失去掌控了。

ex.en: The new manager has a firm grip on the budget.
ex.zh: 新經理把預算掌控得很好。

grip.en: control over something, or understanding of it

grip.zh: get a grip：冷靜下來、振作起來

ex.en: Get a grip on yourself!
ex.zh: 你冷靜一點！

ex.en: Get a grip! It's only a small mistake.
ex.zh: 冷靜點！只是個小錯誤而已。

grip.en: to control your feelings and behave sensibly

ex.en: She gripped my hand tightly.
ex.zh: 她緊緊抓住我的手。

ex.en: The story gripped readers from the first page.
ex.zh: 這個故事從第一頁就吸引住讀者。

grip.en: to hold tightly, or to keep someone's full interest

ex.en: Draw a grid on the paper.
ex.zh: 在紙上畫格子。

ex.en: The city streets are laid out in a grid.
ex.zh: 這座城市的街道呈棋盤狀。

grid.en: a pattern of straight lines that cross each other to form squares

ex.en: The power grid failed during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴風雨期間電網故障。

ex.en: Solar panels feed electricity into the grid.
ex.zh: 太陽能板把電力輸入電網。

grid.en: the network of wires that carries electricity across a country

ex.en: I don't think you quite grasp the idea.
ex.zh: 我覺得你還沒完全理解這個概念。

ex.en: It took me a while to grasp the new system.
ex.zh: 我花了一段時間才搞懂新系統。

ex.en: He grasped the rope with two hands.
ex.zh: 他用雙手抓住繩子。

ex.en: The handle came away from the door when I grasped it.
ex.zh: 我一握住門把，它就從門上掉下來了。

grasp.en: to take hold of something firmly

ex.en: He has a good grasp of English.
ex.zh: 他對英文掌握得很好。

ex.en: She has a firm grasp of the details.
ex.zh: 她對細節掌握得很清楚。

ex.en: They grow strawberries in their greenhouse.
ex.zh: 他們在溫室裡種草莓。

ex.en: These tomatoes are grown in a greenhouse.
ex.zh: 這些番茄是在溫室裡種的。

greenhouse.en: a glass building where plants are grown

greenhouse.zh: greenhouse gas / effect：溫室氣體／溫室效應

ex.en: Saving energy can reduce the emission of greenhouse gases into the atmosphere.
ex.zh: 節約能源可以減少排放到大氣中的溫室氣體。

ex.en: Some scientists believe that the greenhouse effect is imaginary.
ex.zh: 有些科學家認為溫室效應是虛構的。

greenhouse.en: relating to gases that trap heat around the earth and warm it

ex.en: She carried that habit to her grave.
ex.zh: 她到死都改不了那個習慣。

ex.en: We visited my grandfather's grave last weekend.
ex.zh: 我們上週末去掃了爺爺的墓。

grave.en: a place in the ground where a dead person is buried

ex.en: This is a grave mistake.
ex.zh: 這是一個嚴重的錯誤。

ex.en: The doctor had grave concerns about her health.
ex.zh: 醫生非常擔心她的健康狀況。

ex.en: He looked grave when he heard the news.
ex.zh: 他聽到這個消息時神情凝重。

ex.en: The economic outlook is grim.
ex.zh: 經濟前景很嚴峻。

ex.en: The doctor gave us grim news.
ex.zh: 醫生帶來了令人沮喪的消息。

ex.en: Marilla's face was rather grim.
ex.zh: 瑪莉拉的臉色相當陰沉。

ex.en: He looked grim as he read the report.
ex.zh: 他看報告時臉色很凝重。

ex.en: That's a great idea!
ex.zh: 那是個好主意！

ex.en: We had a great time in Tainan.
ex.zh: 我們在台南玩得很愉快。

ex.en: He is one of the greatest artists in Japan.
ex.zh: 他是日本最偉大的藝術家之一。

ex.en: They are considered the greatest rock band in history.
ex.zh: 他們被認為是史上最偉大的搖滾樂團。

great.en: very famous or important because of special ability

ex.en: That you don't believe me is a great pity.
ex.zh: 你不相信我，真是太遺憾了。

ex.en: We have to do a great deal of reading.
ex.zh: 我們必須讀大量的書。

great.en: very large in size, amount or degree

ex.en: The Japanese like to travel in groups.
ex.zh: 日本人喜歡團體旅遊。

ex.en: He tried to unify the various groups.
ex.zh: 他試著把不同的團體統一起來。

ex.en: He doesn't have the ability to manage that group.
ex.zh: 他沒有能力管理那個團隊。

group.en: a number of people or things together

ex.en: He works for a large media group.
ex.zh: 他在一家大型媒體集團工作。

ex.en: The hotel group owns ten hotels in Asia.
ex.zh: 這家飯店集團在亞洲擁有十間飯店。

group.en: a large company made up of several smaller companies

ex.en: The students were grouped by level.
ex.zh: 學生依程度分組。

ex.en: Group the files by date.
ex.zh: 把檔案依日期分類。

group.en: to put people or things into sets

ex.en: Tomatoes grow well in sunny places.
ex.zh: 番茄在陽光充足的地方長得很好。

ex.en: My grandfather grows vegetables in his garden.
ex.zh: 我爺爺在院子裡種菜。

grow.en: to become bigger or taller, or to plant something and help it become bigger

ex.en: The company has grown quickly.
ex.zh: 這家公司成長得很快。

ex.en: Online sales grew by 20% last year.
ex.zh: 去年網路銷售成長了 20%。

grow.en: to become larger in size, number or amount over time

ex.en: Tom and his wife both grew up in Boston.
ex.zh: 湯姆和他太太都在波士頓長大。

ex.en: We didn't have computers when I was growing up.
ex.zh: 我小時候還沒有電腦。

ex.en: He will be a doctor when he grows up.
ex.zh: 他長大後會成為醫生。

grow.en: to change from a child into an adult

ex.en: It's growing dark outside.
ex.zh: 外面天色漸漸暗了。

ex.en: She grew tired of waiting.
ex.zh: 她等得不耐煩了。

grow.en: to slowly start to be in a certain condition

ex.en: The runner jumped over the hole in the ground.
ex.zh: 那位跑者跳過地上的洞。

ex.en: He has the habit of spitting on the ground.
ex.zh: 他有隨地吐痰的習慣。

ground.en: the solid surface of the earth that people walk on

ex.en: Do you have any grounds for thinking so?
ex.zh: 你這麼想有什麼根據嗎？

ex.en: On what grounds are you arresting me?
ex.zh: 你憑什麼逮捕我？

ground.en: the reasons that make you think or do something

ground.zh: 場地、場所；（grounds）庭園、校園範圍

ex.en: Students are forbidden to smoke on the school grounds.
ex.zh: 學生不得在校園內抽菸。

ex.en: The festival grounds were full of people.
ex.zh: 節慶會場擠滿了人。

ground.en: an area of land used for a purpose, or the land around a large building

ex.en: The café is on the ground floor.
ex.zh: 咖啡店在一樓。

ex.en: We live on the ground floor.
ex.zh: 我們住一樓。

ground.en: the floor of a building at the same level as the street

ex.en: These green leaves turn red or yellow in fall.
ex.zh: 這些綠葉到秋天變成紅色或黃色。

ex.en: The forests in Taiwan stay green all year round.
ex.zh: 台灣的森林終年常綠。

green.en: having the color of grass and leaves

ex.en: The company is trying to go green.
ex.zh: 這家公司正努力走向環保。

ex.en: We should use more green energy.
ex.zh: 我們應該多使用綠色能源。

green.en: good for the environment and not harming nature

ex.en: Green is my favorite color.
ex.zh: 綠色是我最喜歡的顏色。

ex.en: She was dressed in green.
ex.zh: 她穿了一身綠。

green.en: the color of grass and leaves

ex.en: The teacher granted me permission to go home early.
ex.zh: 老師准許我提早回家。

ex.en: We were granted the privilege of fishing in this bay.
ex.zh: 我們獲准在這個海灣捕魚。

ex.en: The bank granted us a loan.
ex.zh: 銀行核准了我們的貸款。

grant.en: to officially allow someone to have or do something

ex.en: He was awarded a grant to study in Germany.
ex.zh: 他獲得一筆去德國念書的獎助金。

ex.en: He received a grant to study in Germany.
ex.zh: 他拿到一筆去德國念書的獎助金。

ex.en: The city gave us a grant for the project.
ex.zh: 市政府撥給我們這個專案一筆補助金。

grant.en: an amount of money given by a group for a special purpose

grant.zh: take ... for granted：視為理所當然

ex.en: He took it for granted that I knew the answer.
ex.zh: 他理所當然地認為我知道答案。

ex.en: Don't take your health for granted.
ex.zh: 不要把健康視為理所當然。

grant.en: to expect something to be true or always there without thinking about it

ex.en: I like the gray sweater more than the purple one.
ex.zh: 比起紫色的毛衣，我更喜歡灰色的那件。

ex.en: Could I borrow your gray suit?
ex.zh: 我可以借你的灰色西裝嗎？

gray.en: having the color between black and white

ex.en: I'm getting more and more gray hair.
ex.zh: 我的白頭髮越來越多了。

ex.en: His hair turned gray in his forties.
ex.zh: 他四十幾歲時頭髮就變白了。

gray.en: having hair that is turning white because of age

ex.en: Her hair is streaked with gray.
ex.zh: 她的頭髮夾雜著幾絲灰白。

ex.en: Gray is a popular color for office furniture.
ex.zh: 灰色是辦公家具常見的顏色。

gray.en: the color between black and white

ex.en: This is a gray area in the law.
ex.zh: 這在法律上是灰色地帶。

ex.en: Using company phones for personal calls is a gray area.
ex.zh: 用公司電話打私人電話算是灰色地帶。

gray.en: a situation that is not clear because the rules do not cover it well

ex.en: Grand opening sale.
ex.zh: 盛大開幕特賣。

ex.en: The hotel has a grand lobby with a high ceiling.
ex.zh: 這家飯店有挑高的氣派大廳。

ex.en: They held a grand party for the opening.
ex.zh: 他們為開幕舉辦了盛大的派對。

grand.zh: 總的；最大的（grand total：總計，grand prize：首獎）

ex.en: The grand total comes to 5,000 dollars.
She won the grand prize in the contest.
ex.zh: 她在比賽中得到首獎。

grand.en: including everything in total, or biggest and most important of its kind

ex.en: The population of this country is gradually diminishing.
ex.zh: 這個國家的人口正在逐漸減少。

ex.en: The transition from hardware to software happened gradually.
ex.zh: 從硬體到軟體的轉變是逐步發生的。

ex.en: To be honest, I've gradually come to dislike the life here.
ex.zh: 老實說，我已經漸漸不喜歡這裡的生活了。

gradually.en: in small steps over a long time

ex.en: The children are having fun in the grass.
ex.zh: 孩子們在草地上玩得很開心。

ex.en: The park sign says "Please keep off the grass."
ex.zh: 公園的告示牌寫著「請勿踐踏草地」。

ex.en: I found them lying on the artificial grass.
ex.zh: 我發現他們躺在人工草皮上。

grass.en: a green plant with thin leaves that covers fields and gardens

ex.en: Yanni quickly grabbed the PC and left the room.
ex.zh: 雅尼迅速抓起電腦，離開了房間。

ex.en: She grabbed her bag and ran to the bus.
ex.zh: 她抓起包包，跑去趕公車。

grab.en: to take hold of something quickly and strongly

ex.en: Anybody wanna grab something to eat with me?
ex.zh: 有人想跟我一起去吃點東西嗎？

ex.en: Ziri went to his fridge to grab some milk.
ex.zh: 齊里走到冰箱前去拿點牛奶。

ex.en: Let's grab a coffee before the meeting.
ex.zh: 開會前我們去買杯咖啡吧。

grab.en: to quickly get something, especially food or drink

ex.en: My attention was grabbed by a conversation at the neighbouring table.
ex.zh: 隔壁桌的對話吸引了我的注意。

ex.en: The ad is designed to grab people's attention.
ex.zh: 這支廣告就是為了吸引大家的注意。

grab.en: to make someone notice or become interested

ex.en: The number of tourists has increased greatly in recent years.
ex.zh: 近年來遊客人數大幅增加。

ex.en: It has greatly improved compared with what it was.
ex.zh: 和以前比起來，已經進步很多了。

ex.en: The north and south differ greatly from each other.
ex.zh: 南方和北方差異很大。

ex.en: My grandmother is already more than ninety years old.
ex.zh: 我奶奶已經九十多歲了。

ex.en: I have a dim memory of my grandmother.
ex.zh: 我對奶奶的記憶很模糊。

ex.en: Her grandmother lived to be eighty-eight years old.
ex.zh: 她的祖母活到八十八歲。

grandmother.en: the mother of your mother or father

ex.en: The grammar of Esperanto is very simple.
ex.zh: 世界語的文法很簡單。

ex.en: According to my experience, it takes one year to master French grammar.
ex.zh: 根據我的經驗，要花一年才能掌握法文文法。

ex.en: Please check the grammar before sending the email.
ex.zh: 寄出電子郵件前請檢查文法。

grammar.en: the rules for how words are put together in a language

ex.en: Rye was called the grain of poverty.
ex.zh: 黑麥曾被稱為窮人的穀物。

ex.en: The farmers store grain for the winter.
ex.zh: 農民儲存穀物過冬。

ex.en: Whole grains are good for your health.
ex.zh: 全穀類對健康有益。

grain.en: the small hard seeds of plants like wheat and rice used as food

ex.en: Waste not a single grain of rice!
ex.zh: 一粒米都不要浪費！

ex.en: There isn't a grain of truth in what he says.
ex.zh: 他說的話沒有一點是真的。

grain.en: one very small hard piece of something, or a tiny amount

ex.en: He grinned with delight.
ex.zh: 他開心地咧嘴笑了。

ex.en: I looked at Tom and grinned.
ex.zh: 我看著湯姆咧嘴一笑。

grin.en: to smile widely, showing your teeth

ex.en: He had a big grin on his face.
ex.zh: 他臉上掛著燦爛的笑容。

ex.en: She greeted us with a friendly grin.
ex.zh: 她笑容滿面地跟我們打招呼。

grin.en: a wide smile that shows your teeth

grin.zh: grin and bear it：默默忍受

ex.en: We just have to grin and bear it.
ex.zh: 我們只能默默忍受了。

ex.en: The flight was delayed, so we had to grin and bear it.
ex.zh: 航班延誤了，我們只好默默忍受。

grin.en: to accept something unpleasant without complaining

ex.en: The road has a steep gradient.
ex.zh: 這條路坡度很陡。

ex.en: Trains slow down on steep gradients.
ex.zh: 火車在陡坡上會減速。

gradient.en: how steeply a road or piece of land goes up or down

ex.en: The poster uses a gradient from blue to purple.
ex.zh: 海報使用從藍色到紫色的漸層。

ex.en: Add a color gradient to the background.
ex.zh: 在背景加上顏色漸層。

gradient.en: a slow change from one color to another

ex.en: He made many grammatical mistakes in his composition.
ex.zh: 他的作文有很多文法錯誤。

ex.en: He made a few grammatical mistakes.
ex.zh: 他犯了幾個文法錯誤。

grammatical.en: relating to the rules of language

ex.en: Is this sentence grammatical?
ex.zh: 這個句子合乎文法嗎？

ex.en: The sentence is grammatical, but it sounds odd.
ex.zh: 這句話合乎文法，但聽起來很怪。

grammatical.en: correct according to the rules of language

ex.en: It's gravity that makes satellites move around the Earth.
ex.zh: 讓衛星繞著地球轉的是重力。

ex.en: They conducted a series of experiments under zero gravity.
ex.zh: 他們在無重力狀態下進行了一系列實驗。

ex.en: Einstein predicted that the Sun's gravity would bend light.
ex.zh: 愛因斯坦預測太陽的重力會讓光線彎曲。

gravity.en: the force that pulls things toward the earth

ex.en: He didn't understand the gravity of the situation.
ex.zh: 他不了解情勢的嚴重性。

ex.en: The gravity of the mistake became clear later.
ex.zh: 這個錯誤的嚴重程度後來才顯現出來。

gravity.en: how serious and important a situation is

ex.en: Mrs. Parker greeted him with a smile.
ex.zh: 帕克太太微笑著跟他打招呼。

ex.en: Susan greeted her guests at the door.
ex.zh: 蘇珊在門口迎接她的客人。

ex.en: I didn't greet you because I mistook you for somebody else.
ex.zh: 我把你認成了別人，所以才沒有和你打招呼。

greet.en: to say hello to someone or welcome them

ex.en: I'd be very grateful if you could help me.
ex.zh: 如果你能幫我，我會非常感激。

ex.en: I'm very grateful for everything you've done for me.
ex.zh: 非常感謝你為我做的一切。

ex.en: I'm grateful to you for inviting me to the party.
ex.zh: 謝謝你邀我參加派對。

grateful.en: feeling thankful to someone for what they did

ex.en: I live with my mother, brother and my grandparents.
ex.zh: 我和媽媽，弟弟還有爺爺奶奶住在一起。

ex.en: Lucy was brought up by her grandparents.
ex.zh: 露西是祖父母帶大的。

ex.en: Tom went to Boston to spend Christmas with his grandparents.
ex.zh: 湯姆去波士頓陪爺爺奶奶過聖誕節。

grandparent.en: the mother or father of your mother or father

ex.en: I bought a handmade dried persimmon in Hsinchu. It tastes sweet but not greasy.
ex.zh: 我在新竹買了一塊手工柿餅，吃起來甜而不膩。

ex.en: This fried rice is too greasy.
ex.zh: 這盤炒飯太油了。

greasy.en: containing or covered with a lot of oil or fat

ex.en: No gratuity accepted.
ex.zh: 本店不收小費。

ex.en: A 10% gratuity is added to the bill.
ex.zh: 帳單會另加 10% 的小費。

gratuity.en: extra money you give to a worker for good service

ex.en: Greed is always hungry.
ex.zh: 吃著碗裡，看著鍋裡。

ex.en: His greed for money destroyed his friendships.
ex.zh: 他對金錢的貪婪毀了他的友誼。

greed.en: a strong wish to have more money or things than you need

ex.en: He grieved at the death of his best friend.
ex.zh: 他為他最要好的朋友的死感到悲傷。

ex.en: She grieved for her husband for many years.
ex.zh: 她為丈夫哀悼了很多年。

ex.en: It grieves me to see you so unhappy.
ex.zh: 看到你這麼不快樂，我很難過。

grieve.en: to feel very sad, especially because someone died

ex.en: The soldier groaned with pain.
ex.zh: 這名士兵痛苦地呻吟。

ex.en: The students groaned when the teacher announced a test.
ex.zh: 老師宣布要考試，學生們都哀嚎了起來。

groan.en: to make a long low sound because of pain or unhappiness

ex.en: He let out a groan of pain and sat down.
ex.zh: 他發出一聲痛苦的呻吟並坐了下來。

ex.en: A groan went through the crowd when the team lost.
ex.zh: 球隊輸球時，觀眾席上傳來一陣哀嘆聲。

groan.en: a long low sound made because of pain or unhappiness

ex.en: The workers grumbled about the long hours.
ex.zh: 工人們抱怨工時太長。

ex.en: He grumbled all the way home about the bad service.
ex.zh: 他一路抱怨著糟糕的服務回家。

grumble.en: to complain in a quiet, unhappy way

ex.en: They exchanged formal greetings.
ex.zh: 他們客套地互相打了招呼。

ex.en: She sent holiday greetings to all her old classmates.
ex.zh: 她向所有老同學寄送了節日問候。

greeting.en: something polite you say or do when you meet someone

ex.en: My grandson is still a baby.
ex.zh: 我的孫子還是個嬰兒。

ex.en: Perhaps my grandson will be the first person to land on Mars.
ex.zh: 可能我的孫子會是登陸火星的第一人。

ex.en: My grandson visits us every Sunday and helps me in the garden.
ex.zh: 我孫子每個星期天都來看我們，還幫我整理花園。

grandson.en: the son of your son or daughter

ex.en: She is gracious to everyone.
ex.zh: 她對誰都很和藹可親。

ex.en: Our host was gracious and made everyone feel welcome.
ex.zh: 主人親切有禮，讓每個人都賓至如歸。

ex.en: She was gracious enough to congratulate the winner.
ex.zh: 她很有風度地向勝利者道賀。

gracious.en: kind, polite and pleasant to other people

ex.en: We cleaned our grandfather's gravestone during Tomb Sweeping Day.
ex.zh: 清明節時，我們清理了爺爺的墓碑。

ex.en: The old gravestones in the churchyard were covered in moss.
ex.zh: 教堂墓園裡的老墓碑都長滿了青苔。

gravestone.en: a stone that marks the place where a dead person is buried

ex.en: Few people recognized the artist's greatness during his lifetime.
ex.zh: 這位藝術家生前很少有人看出他的偉大。

ex.en: The coach saw signs of greatness in the young player.
ex.zh: 教練在這名年輕球員身上看到了成為頂尖人物的潛力。

greatness.en: the quality of being very important or very good

ex.en: More money for education will spur economic growth.
ex.zh: 增加教育經費將刺激經濟成長。

ex.en: The third quarter GNP growth was 1% over the preceding quarter.
ex.zh: 第三季國民生產毛額比上一季成長了 1%。

ex.en: The rapid growth in imports amazes us.
ex.zh: 進口量快速成長，讓我們很驚訝。

growth.en: an increase in size, number or amount

ex.en: Children need protein for healthy growth.
ex.zh: 孩子需要蛋白質才能健康成長。

ex.en: Water and sunlight are needed for plant growth.
ex.zh: 植物生長需要水和陽光。

growth.en: the process of a living thing getting bigger

ex.en: The project lead expressed her gratitude to the staff who stayed late.
ex.zh: 專案負責人向加班留下來的同仁表達謝意。

ex.en: As a token of gratitude, the supplier sent the warehouse team lunch.
ex.zh: 供應商送午餐給倉庫團隊，藉此表達感謝。

ex.en: Employees can file a grievance with human resources.
ex.zh: 員工可以向人資部門提出申訴。

ex.en: The manager addressed her grievance promptly.
ex.zh: 經理迅速處理了她的不滿。

grievance.en: a complaint about something you think is unfair

ex.en: A stalled truck caused gridlock on the expressway.
ex.zh: 一輛故障貨車造成快速道路交通癱瘓。

ex.en: Negotiations reached gridlock over the proposed budget cuts.
ex.zh: 雙方因預定刪減預算而陷入談判僵局。

gridlock.en: a situation where traffic or progress cannot move at all

ex.en: The graph shows a steady increase in prices.
ex.zh: 這張曲線圖顯示價格穩定上升。

ex.en: Plot the results on a graph.
ex.zh: 把結果畫在圖表上。

graph.en: a drawing that shows how numbers or amounts are related

ex.en: There is a growing interest in healthy food.
ex.zh: 人們對健康食品的興趣日益增加。

ex.en: She has a growing family to take care of.
ex.zh: 她要照顧一個日漸壯大的家庭。

ex.en: Growing children need plenty of sleep.
ex.zh: 成長中的孩子需要充足的睡眠。

ex.en: It's a fast growing town near the coast.
ex.zh: 這是一座靠海、快速發展的城鎮。

ex.en: He wore a grey jacket to the interview.
ex.zh: 他穿著一件灰色外套去面試。

ex.en: The sky turned grey before the rain started.
ex.zh: 下雨之前天空變成了灰色。

ex.en: It was a cold, grey morning in the city.
ex.zh: 那是城裡一個寒冷又陰沉的早晨。

ex.en: Everything felt grey after the bad news.
ex.zh: 聽到壞消息後，一切都顯得灰暗。

ex.en: I painted the walls light grey.
ex.zh: 我把牆壁漆成淺灰色。

ex.en: Grey goes well with almost any color.
ex.zh: 灰色幾乎和任何顏色都很搭。

ex.en: My grandfather tells us stories every summer.
ex.zh: 我爺爺每年夏天都會講故事給我們聽。

ex.en: She visits her grandfather every Sunday.
ex.zh: 她每個星期天都去看她的外公。

ex.en: His grandfather used to be a fisherman.
ex.zh: 他的祖父以前是漁夫。

ex.en: She was overcome with grief after her grandfather died.
ex.zh: 祖父過世後，她陷入深深的悲痛。

ex.en: Friends tried to ease his grief with kind words.
ex.zh: 朋友們用溫暖的話語試著減輕他的悲傷。

ex.en: She danced with grace and ease.
ex.zh: 她舞姿優雅而輕鬆。

ex.en: He accepted the loss with grace.
ex.zh: 他很有風度地接受了失敗。

ex.en: We said grace before dinner.
ex.zh: 我們在晚餐前做了謝飯禱告。

ex.en: They believe they were saved by the grace of God.
ex.zh: 他們相信自己是靠神的恩典得救的。

ex.en: The bank gave us a week's grace to pay.
ex.zh: 銀行給了我們一週的寬限期來付款。

ex.en: There is a ten-day grace period for late fees.
ex.zh: 逾期費用有十天的寬限期。

ex.en: Her grandchild visits her every summer and stays for a week.
ex.zh: 她有三個孫子孫女，每年夏天都會來看她。

ex.en: Grandpa gave his youngest grandchild a toy train.
ex.zh: 爺爺送給他最小的孫子一台玩具火車。

ex.en: She bought a bunch of green grapes at the market.
ex.zh: 她在市場買了一串青葡萄。

ex.en: This grape juice is sweet and very fresh.
ex.zh: 這杯葡萄汁又甜又新鮮。

ex.en: The car drove slowly along the gravel road.
ex.zh: 那輛車沿著碎石路慢慢地開。

ex.en: They spread gravel on the garden path.
ex.zh: 他們在花園小徑上鋪了碎石。

ex.en: He is the greatest basketball player of his generation.
ex.zh: 他是他那個世代最偉大的籃球員。

ex.en: Being a mother is the greatest joy of her life.
ex.zh: 當媽媽是她人生中最大的快樂。

ex.en: That was the greatest meal I have ever eaten.
ex.zh: 那是我吃過最棒的一餐。

ex.en: We made s'mores with graham crackers and chocolate.
ex.zh: 我們用全麥餅乾和巧克力做了夾心棉花糖餅乾。

ex.en: She prefers graham flour when baking healthy bread.
ex.zh: 她烤健康麵包時比較喜歡用全麥麵粉。

ex.en: Greece is famous for its beautiful islands.
ex.zh: 希臘以美麗的島嶼聞名。

ex.en: Athens is the capital of Greece.
ex.zh: 雅典是希臘的首都。

ex.en: We ate Greek salad at a small restaurant by the sea.
ex.zh: 我們在海邊一家小餐館吃了希臘沙拉。

ex.en: She is studying Greek history at university.
ex.zh: 她在大學主修希臘歷史。

ex.en: He is learning Greek so he can read old texts.
ex.zh: 他正在學希臘語，好讀懂古老的文獻。

ex.en: Many Greeks enjoy spending summer days on the islands.
ex.zh: 許多希臘人喜歡在島上度過夏天。

ex.en: A greater number of people came to the event this year.
ex.zh: 今年來參加活動的人數更多。

ex.en: The city's greater need is for more affordable housing.
ex.zh: 這座城市更迫切的需求是更多負擔得起的住房。

ex.en: She felt that helping others was a greater goal than making money.
ex.zh: 她覺得幫助別人是比賺錢更崇高的目標。

ex.en: There is no greater joy than seeing your child succeed.
ex.zh: 沒有什麼比看到孩子成功更令人高興了。

ex.en: The teacher explained the grouping of students for the project.
ex.zh: 老師說明了這次專題的學生分組方式。

ex.en: This grouping of colors makes the room feel warm.
ex.zh: 這種配色組合讓房間感覺很溫暖。

ex.en: The grouping of words by topic helps me memorize them.
ex.zh: 把單字依主題分組有助於我記憶。

ex.en: There has been a gradual change in the weather.
ex.zh: 天氣出現了逐漸的變化。

ex.en: Learning a language is a slow and gradual process.
ex.zh: 學語言是一個緩慢又漸進的過程。

ex.en: The doctor recommended a gradual return to exercise.
ex.zh: 醫生建議逐步恢復運動。

ex.en: He grinds fresh coffee beans every morning.
ex.zh: 他每天早上現磨咖啡豆。

ex.en: Grind the pepper over the soup just before serving.
ex.zh: 上菜前把胡椒研磨撒在湯上。

ex.en: The old mill used to grind wheat into flour.
ex.zh: 那座老磨坊過去用來把小麥磨成麵粉。

ex.en: The daily grind of the office wore her out.
ex.zh: 辦公室日復一日的苦差事讓她筋疲力盡。

ex.en: Studying for the exam was a real grind.
ex.zh: 準備那場考試真是件苦差事。

ex.en: The grower sells fresh tomatoes at the market every Saturday.
ex.zh: 那位種植者每週六在市場賣新鮮番茄。

ex.en: Local apple growers worry about the cold weather this spring.
ex.zh: 當地的蘋果種植戶擔心今年春天的低溫。

ex.en: We had a picnic in a grove of olive trees.
ex.zh: 我們在一片橄欖樹林裡野餐。

ex.en: A small grove behind the house gives us shade in summer.
ex.zh: 房子後面的一小片樹林在夏天為我們遮蔭。

ex.en: Greg is short for Gregory.
ex.zh: Greg 是 Gregory 的簡稱。

ex.en: Greg usually takes the train to work.
ex.zh: 格雷格通常搭火車上班。

ex.en: The kitchen has a smooth granite countertop.
ex.zh: 這間廚房有光滑的花崗岩檯面。

ex.en: The monument is made of solid granite.
ex.zh: 這座紀念碑是用堅硬的花崗岩做成的。

ex.en: We ordered grilled fish with lemon and rice.
ex.zh: 我們點了檸檬烤魚配飯。

ex.en: He likes grilled corn with a little butter.
ex.zh: 他喜歡抹點奶油的烤玉米。

ex.en: The police grilled him for hours about the missing money.
ex.zh: 警方就失蹤的錢盤問了他好幾個小時。

ex.en: My parents grilled me about where I had been all night.
ex.zh: 爸媽盤問我整晚去了哪裡。

ex.en: Cows graze in the green field all summer.
ex.zh: 整個夏天，母牛都在綠色的牧場上吃草。

ex.en: The farmer lets his sheep graze on the hillside.
ex.zh: 農夫讓羊群在山坡上吃草。

ex.en: He fell and grazed his knee on the pavement.
ex.zh: 他跌倒時膝蓋在人行道上擦傷了。

ex.en: The ball grazed the edge of the table and rolled away.
ex.zh: 球擦過桌子邊緣後滾走了。

ex.en: She had a small graze on her elbow.
ex.zh: 她的手肘上有一處小擦傷。

ex.en: The nurse cleaned the graze and put a bandage on it.
ex.zh: 護理師清理了擦傷並貼上繃帶。

ex.en: The door slides along a groove in the floor.
ex.zh: 門沿著地板上的凹槽滑動。

ex.en: Dust had collected in every groove of the old wooden table.
ex.zh: 舊木桌的每一道溝紋裡都積了灰塵。

ex.en: The band quickly found its groove during the second song.
ex.zh: 樂團在第二首歌時很快就找到了節奏感。

ex.en: This bass line has a great groove.
ex.zh: 這段貝斯旋律的律動感很棒。

ex.en: My brother is a fifth grader at the local school.
ex.zh: 我弟弟是本地學校的五年級生。

ex.en: The second graders put on a short play for their parents.
ex.zh: 二年級的學生為家長演了一齣短劇。

ex.en: The grader marked her essay without knowing her name.
ex.zh: 評分者在不知道她姓名的情況下批改了她的作文。

ex.en: Each grader checks twenty exams a day.
ex.zh: 每位閱卷者一天要批改二十份考卷。

ex.en: Granny knits me a scarf every winter.
ex.zh: 奶奶每年冬天都織一條圍巾給我。

ex.en: We visit Granny on Sundays for lunch.
ex.zh: 我們星期天去奶奶家吃午餐。

ex.en: The dancer made a graceful turn across the stage.
ex.zh: 舞者優美地在舞台上轉了一圈。

ex.en: Swans are known for their graceful movements on the water.
ex.zh: 天鵝以水面上優雅的動作聞名。

ex.en: The software has a simple graphical interface.
ex.zh: 這套軟體有簡單的圖形介面。

ex.en: The report includes a graphical summary of the results.
ex.zh: 報告中附有結果的圖解摘要。

ex.en: The museum displays an old grenade from the war.
ex.zh: 博物館展示著一枚戰時留下的舊手榴彈。

ex.en: The soldier was trained to handle a grenade safely.
ex.zh: 那名士兵受過安全處理手榴彈的訓練。

ex.en: There was grease all over the kitchen stove.
ex.zh: 整個廚房的爐子上都是油漬。

ex.en: The mechanic put some grease on the bike chain.
ex.zh: 技師在腳踏車鏈條上塗了一些潤滑油。

ex.en: She greased the pan before pouring in the batter.
ex.zh: 她在倒入麵糊前先在烤盤上抹了油。

ex.en: You should grease the hinges so the door stops squeaking.
ex.zh: 你應該給門的鉸鏈上油，這樣門才不會吱吱作響。

ex.en: The dog began to growl when a stranger came near.
ex.zh: 陌生人靠近時，那隻狗開始低吼。

ex.en: I could hear my stomach growl during the meeting.
ex.zh: 開會時，我聽得到自己的肚子咕嚕叫。

ex.en: We heard a low growl coming from the bushes.
ex.zh: 我們聽見灌木叢裡傳來一聲低吼。

ex.en: The bear gave a loud growl and ran off.
ex.zh: 那隻熊大吼一聲後跑走了。

ex.en: My gran bakes the best cookies in the world.
ex.zh: 我奶奶烤的餅乾是世界上最好吃的。

ex.en: We visit Gran every Sunday afternoon.
ex.zh: 我們每個週日下午都去看奶奶。

ex.en: He nodded grimly and walked out of the room.
ex.zh: 他嚴肅地點了點頭，走出房間。

ex.en: The doctor spoke grimly about the long road ahead.
ex.zh: 醫生神情凝重地談起前面漫長的路。

ex.en: The two boys grappled on the ground until a teacher stopped them.
ex.zh: 兩個男孩在地上扭打，直到老師制止他們。

ex.en: Many students grapple with difficult math problems.
ex.zh: 許多學生都在努力對付困難的數學題。

ex.en: The moon's gravitational pull causes the ocean tides.
ex.zh: 月球的引力造成海洋潮汐。

ex.en: Scientists study gravitational forces between planets.
ex.zh: 科學家研究行星之間的引力。

ex.en: The greenbelt around the city protects the farmland.
ex.zh: 城市周圍的綠化帶保護著農地。

ex.en: We walk along the greenbelt every weekend.
ex.zh: 我們每個週末都沿著綠地帶散步。

ex.en: Grate the cheese and sprinkle it over the pasta.
ex.zh: 把起司刨成絲，撒在義大利麵上。

ex.en: She grated a carrot for the salad.
ex.zh: 她刨了一根紅蘿蔔做沙拉。

ex.en: His loud laugh began to grate on my nerves.
ex.zh: 他響亮的笑聲開始讓我心煩。

ex.en: The sound of chalk on the board grates on everyone's ears.
ex.zh: 粉筆刮過黑板的聲音讓每個人都覺得刺耳。

ex.en: She put a log on the grate and lit the fire.
ex.zh: 她把一根木柴放在爐柵上並生了火。

ex.en: Leaves had blocked the iron grate over the drain.
ex.zh: 落葉堵住了排水口上的鐵格柵。

ex.en: My granddaughter is learning to ride a bike.
ex.zh: 我的孫女正在學騎腳踏車。

ex.en: He showed everyone a photo of his new granddaughter.
ex.zh: 他給大家看他剛出生的孫女的照片。

ex.en: Grandma knitted a hat for her granddaughter.
ex.zh: 奶奶為她的孫女織了一頂帽子。

ex.en: She has five grandchildren who visit every summer.
ex.zh: 她有五個孫子女，每年夏天都會來探望。

ex.en: Grandpa tells stories to his grandchildren before bed.
ex.zh: 爺爺睡前會對孫子們講故事。

ex.en: They left the house to their grandchildren.
ex.zh: 他們把房子留給了孫輩。

ex.en: The greedy man wanted all the money for himself.
ex.zh: 那個貪心的男人想把所有的錢都據為己有。

ex.en: Don't be greedy; share the cake with your sister.
ex.zh: 別貪心，和你妹妹分享蛋糕。

ex.en: The greedy cat ate all the fish in one go.
ex.zh: 那隻貪吃的貓一口氣把魚全吃光了。

ex.en: The groom waited nervously at the front of the church.
ex.zh: 新郎緊張地在教堂前方等待。

ex.en: The bride and groom cut the cake together.
ex.zh: 新郎新娘一起切蛋糕。

groom.zh: 打理儀容；幫動物梳理毛髮

ex.en: She spends an hour each morning grooming her horse.
ex.zh: 她每天早上花一小時幫她的馬梳理毛髮。

ex.en: He groomed himself carefully before the job interview.
ex.zh: 他在面試前仔細打理了自己的儀容。

ex.en: The company is grooming her to become the next manager.
ex.zh: 公司正在栽培她成為下一任經理。

ex.en: He was groomed from a young age to take over the family business.
ex.zh: 他從小就被培養要接手家族事業。

ex.en: Someone sprayed graffiti on the wall of the school.
ex.zh: 有人在學校的牆上噴了塗鴉。

ex.en: The city organized a team to clean off the graffiti.
ex.zh: 市政府組織了一個小組來清除塗鴉。

ex.en: Many villages get their drinking water from groundwater.
ex.zh: 許多村莊的飲用水來自地下水。

ex.en: Chemicals from the factory polluted the groundwater.
ex.zh: 工廠排出的化學物質污染了地下水。

ex.en: There was grit in my shoe after the walk on the beach.
ex.zh: 我在海灘散步後，鞋子裡進了砂礫。

ex.en: Workers spread grit on the icy road.
ex.zh: 工人在結冰的路面上撒了砂粒。

ex.en: It takes real grit to finish a marathon.
ex.zh: 要跑完馬拉松需要真正的毅力。

ex.en: She showed great grit after losing her job.
ex.zh: 丟了工作後，她展現出極大的堅韌。

ex.en: He gritted his teeth and kept running.
ex.zh: 他咬緊牙關繼續跑。

ex.en: I just have to grit my teeth and get through this week.
ex.zh: 我只能咬緊牙關撐過這個星期。

ex.en: She poured hot gravy over the mashed potatoes.
ex.zh: 她把熱肉汁淋在馬鈴薯泥上。

ex.en: The turkey was served with a rich brown gravy.
ex.zh: 火雞搭配濃郁的褐色肉汁一起上桌。

ex.en: He grunted and kept reading his newspaper.
ex.zh: 他咕噥了一聲，繼續看報紙。

ex.en: The weightlifter grunted as he lifted the bar.
ex.zh: 舉重選手舉起槓鈴時發出了悶哼聲。

ex.en: I only got a grunt in reply.
ex.zh: 我得到的回應只是一聲咕噥。

ex.en: With a grunt, he picked up the heavy box.
ex.zh: 他哼了一聲，搬起那個沉重的箱子。

ex.en: Grandma bakes cookies whenever we visit.
ex.zh: 我們每次去，奶奶都會烤餅乾。

ex.en: I called grandma to wish her a happy birthday.
ex.zh: 我打電話給外婆，祝她生日快樂。

ex.en: The price was grossly unfair to customers.
ex.zh: 這個價格對顧客極不公平。

ex.en: The test results were grossly exaggerated in the news.
ex.zh: 測試結果在新聞中被嚴重誇大了。

ex.en: The old church has a quiet graveyard behind it.
ex.zh: 那座老教堂後面有一片安靜的墓地。

ex.en: We walked past the graveyard on our way home.
ex.zh: 我們回家的路上經過那片墓地。

greenwich.zh: （地名）格林威治，倫敦東南部地區

ex.en: Greenwich is the place where the prime meridian passes through.
ex.zh: 本初子午線就通過格林威治。

ex.en: Many tourists visit Greenwich to see the Royal Observatory.
ex.zh: 許多遊客造訪格林威治，參觀皇家天文台。

ex.en: Visitors were amazed by the grandeur of the mountains.
ex.zh: 遊客對群山的壯麗景色讚嘆不已。

ex.en: The palace still shows signs of its former grandeur.
ex.zh: 這座宮殿仍保有昔日宏偉的痕跡。

ex.en: We had a picnic on a grassy hill.
ex.zh: 我們在一座長滿青草的小山丘上野餐。

ex.en: The path ended at a grassy field.
ex.zh: 小路的盡頭是一片草地。

ex.en: I groped for the light switch in the dark.
ex.zh: 我在黑暗中摸索電燈開關。

ex.en: He groped around his bag for his keys.
ex.zh: 他在包包裡摸來摸去找鑰匙。

ex.en: She gratefully accepted the offer of a ride home.
ex.zh: 她感激地接受了送她回家的提議。

ex.en: "Thank you so much," he said gratefully.
ex.zh: 「非常謝謝你。」他感激地說。

ex.en: The villagers gratefully received food from the volunteers.
ex.zh: 村民們感激地收下了志工送來的食物。

ex.en: She is a recent grad looking for her first job.
ex.zh: 她是剛畢業的社會新鮮人，正在找第一份工作。

ex.en: The company hires many grads each summer.
ex.zh: 這家公司每年夏天都會雇用許多畢業生。

ex.en: My roommate is a grad studying chemistry.
ex.zh: 我的室友是讀化學的研究生。

ex.en: Grads often teach classes in the lab.
ex.zh: 研究生常常要在實驗室帶課。

ex.en: She is still grieving for her grandfather.
ex.zh: 她仍為她的祖父感到悲痛。

ex.en: Grieving takes time, and everyone does it differently.
ex.zh: 哀悼需要時間，而且每個人的方式都不同。

ex.en: The whole town was grieving after the accident.
ex.zh: 事故過後，全鎮都沉浸在悲痛中。

ex.en: The soccer player pulled a muscle in his groin.
ex.zh: 那位足球員的鼠蹊部肌肉拉傷了。

ex.en: The nurse checked for swelling near my groin.
ex.zh: 護理師檢查我鼠蹊部附近有沒有腫脹。

gritty.zh: 有砂礫的；堅毅的；寫實硬派的

ex.en: The rice was gritty because it hadn't been washed well.
ex.zh: 米沒洗乾淨，吃起來有砂礫感。

ex.en: She is a gritty player who never gives up.
ex.zh: 她是個不輕言放棄的堅毅球員。

ex.en: The film gives a gritty picture of life in the city.
ex.zh: 這部電影對都市生活做了寫實而不加修飾的描繪。

ex.en: The dancer moved gracefully across the stage.
ex.zh: 舞者優雅地走過舞台。

ex.en: He accepted the loss gracefully and shook hands.
ex.zh: 他風度翩翩地接受落敗並與對手握手。

ex.en: The swan glided gracefully over the lake.
ex.zh: 天鵝優雅地滑過湖面。

ex.en: The old grange stood at the end of a country lane.
ex.zh: 那座老農莊坐落在鄉間小路的盡頭。

ex.en: They turned the grange into a small hotel.
ex.zh: 他們把這座莊園改成了小旅館。

ex.en: Cattle graze on the open grassland.
ex.zh: 牛群在遼闊的草原上吃草。

ex.en: Many wild animals live in the African grassland.
ex.zh: 許多野生動物棲息在非洲的草原上。

ex.en: He made a grimace when he tasted the bitter medicine.
ex.zh: 他嚐到苦藥時皺起了臉。

ex.en: A grimace of pain crossed her face as she stood up.
ex.zh: 她站起來時臉上閃過一絲痛苦的表情。

grimace.zh: 做鬼臉；因痛苦或厭惡而皺臉

ex.en: The boy grimaced and refused to eat his vegetables.
ex.zh: 男孩皺著臉，不肯吃他的蔬菜。

ex.en: She grimaced when she saw the price on the menu.
ex.zh: 她看到菜單上的價格時皺起了眉頭。

ex.en: Pencil lead is made of graphite and clay.
ex.zh: 鉛筆芯是用石墨和黏土做成的。

ex.en: Graphite conducts electricity quite well.
ex.zh: 石墨的導電性相當好。

gruesome.zh: 可怕的；令人毛骨悚然的

ex.en: The film contains a few gruesome scenes.
ex.zh: 這部電影有幾個令人毛骨悚然的畫面。

ex.en: The newspaper described the accident in gruesome detail.
ex.zh: 報紙以令人不寒而慄的細節描述了那場意外。

ex.en: The teachers laid the groundwork for the new program.
ex.zh: 老師們為新課程打下了基礎。

ex.en: Good groundwork will save time later in the project.
ex.zh: 充分的前期準備能讓專案後面省下時間。

ex.en: The grocer knows all his customers by name.
ex.zh: 雜貨店老闆認得所有顧客的名字。

ex.en: I bought fruit from the local grocer.
ex.zh: 我向當地的雜貨店買了水果。

ex.en: I usually have half a grapefruit for breakfast.
ex.zh: 我早餐通常吃半顆葡萄柚。

ex.en: Fresh grapefruit juice tastes a little sour and bitter.
ex.zh: 新鮮葡萄柚汁嚐起來有點酸又有點苦。

ex.en: The kids came home with grubby hands after playing in the mud.
ex.zh: 孩子們在泥巴裡玩完後，帶著髒兮兮的雙手回家。

ex.en: He wore a grubby old T-shirt to paint the fence.
ex.zh: 他穿著一件髒舊的T恤去粉刷圍籬。

ex.en: The doctor spoke gravely about the patient's condition.
ex.zh: 醫生神情嚴肅地談論病人的狀況。

ex.en: The soldier was gravely injured in the accident.
ex.zh: 那名士兵在事故中受了重傷。

ex.en: He made a grievous mistake that cost the company a lot of money.
ex.zh: 他犯了一個嚴重的錯誤，讓公司損失慘重。

ex.en: The family suffered a grievous loss when the old house burned down.
ex.zh: 老房子燒毀時，這個家庭遭受了沉重的損失。

ex.en: She was left with grievous injuries after the accident.
ex.zh: 那場意外讓她受了嚴重的傷。

grotesque.zh: 怪誕的；醜陋得令人不適的

ex.en: The mask had a grotesque face with a huge nose.
ex.zh: 那個面具有一張鼻子超大的怪異臉孔。

ex.en: It was grotesque to see so much food wasted at the party.
ex.zh: 看到派對上浪費那麼多食物，真令人反感。

ex.en: The monster in the movie was grotesque but a little funny.
ex.zh: 電影裡的怪物長得很怪異，卻有點好笑。

ex.en: He felt great gratification when he finished the marathon.
ex.zh: 他跑完馬拉松時感到莫大的滿足。

ex.en: Some people want instant gratification and hate waiting.
ex.zh: 有些人想要立即得到滿足，討厭等待。

ex.en: Helping others brings her deep gratification.
ex.zh: 幫助別人讓她深感欣慰。

ex.en: My grandfather still keeps an old gramophone in the living room.
ex.zh: 我祖父客廳裡還留著一台老留聲機。

ex.en: Music from the gramophone filled the small cafe.
ex.zh: 留聲機的音樂充滿了這間小咖啡館。

ex.en: Grazing is common in these wide green valleys.
ex.zh: 在這些寬廣綠意的山谷中，放牧很常見。

ex.en: The land is used for grazing sheep.
ex.zh: 這塊地被用來放牧綿羊。

ex.en: Cows were grazing quietly in the field.
ex.zh: 幾頭乳牛正在田野裡安靜地吃草。

ex.en: The horses are grazing near the river.
ex.zh: 馬群正在河邊吃草。

ex.en: The teacher is grading the exams tonight.
ex.zh: 老師今晚正在批改考卷。

ex.en: I spent the weekend grading homework.
ex.zh: 我整個週末都在批改作業。

ex.en: The grading of apples depends on size and color.
ex.zh: 蘋果的分級取決於大小和顏色。

ex.en: Fair grading helps students trust their teachers.
ex.zh: 公平的評分讓學生信任老師。

gravitate.zh: 被吸引；自然而然地趨向

ex.en: Young people often gravitate toward big cities.
ex.zh: 年輕人常常自然而然地往大城市聚集。

ex.en: Children tend to gravitate to the brightest toys.
ex.zh: 孩子們往往會被最鮮豔的玩具吸引過去。

ex.en: Greenland is the largest island in the world.
ex.zh: 格陵蘭是世界上最大的島。

ex.en: Most of Greenland is covered by a thick sheet of ice.
ex.zh: 格陵蘭大部分地區被厚厚的冰層覆蓋。

ex.en: A grizzly can weigh more than three hundred kilograms.
ex.zh: 一隻灰熊的體重可以超過三百公斤。

ex.en: We saw a grizzly fishing in the river at the national park.
ex.zh: 我們在國家公園裡看見一隻灰熊在河裡捕魚。

ex.en: My grandad tells the best stories about his childhood.
ex.zh: 我爺爺很會講他小時候的故事。

ex.en: We visit Grandad every Sunday for lunch.
ex.zh: 我們每個星期天都去外公家吃午餐。

ex.en: Each granule of sugar dissolved quickly in the hot tea.
ex.zh: 每一顆糖粒在熱茶裡很快就溶化了。

ex.en: The medicine comes as small granules you mix with water.
ex.zh: 這種藥是小顆粒狀的，要用水沖服。

ex.en: I grind my beans fresh with a coffee grinder every morning.
ex.zh: 我每天早上用磨豆機現磨咖啡豆。

ex.en: The cook put the meat through a grinder.
ex.zh: 廚師把肉放進絞肉機中絞碎。

ex.en: Sprinkle some grated cheese over the pasta.
ex.zh: 在義大利麵上撒些起司絲。

ex.en: The salad had grated carrots and cabbage in it.
ex.zh: 這份沙拉裡有紅蘿蔔絲和高麗菜絲。

grated.zh: 刨絲；磨碎（grate 的過去式）

ex.en: She grated the lemon peel into the batter.
ex.zh: 她把檸檬皮刨成屑加進麵糊裡。

ex.en: I grated a little ginger and added it to the soup.
ex.zh: 我磨了一點薑加進湯裡。

grinding.zh: 磨；磨碎（grind 的現在分詞）

ex.en: He is grinding coffee beans for breakfast.
ex.zh: 他正在磨早餐要喝的咖啡豆。

ex.en: The machine was grinding wheat into flour.
ex.zh: 機器正把小麥磨成麵粉。

ex.en: Many families live in grinding poverty.
ex.zh: 許多家庭過著赤貧的生活。

ex.en: The grinding work left him tired every night.
ex.zh: 那份辛苦的工作讓他每晚都筋疲力盡。

ex.en: The singer won a Grammy for her first album.
ex.zh: 那位歌手憑藉她的第一張專輯贏得葛萊美獎。

ex.en: The Grammy is a music award given every year in the United States.
ex.zh: 葛萊美獎是美國每年頒發的音樂獎項。

gratifying.zh: 令人滿足的；令人欣慰的

ex.en: It was gratifying to see my students pass the exam.
ex.zh: 看到學生通過考試，我覺得很欣慰。

ex.en: The team's success was a gratifying reward for months of work.
ex.zh: 團隊的成功是對數個月努力的欣慰回報。

ex.en: He described the accident so graphically that I felt sick.
ex.zh: 他把那場事故描述得太生動，讓我覺得不舒服。

ex.en: The data is shown graphically in the second chart.
ex.zh: 資料以圖表方式呈現在第二張圖中。

ex.en: He made grandiose plans that he never finished.
ex.zh: 他訂了許多浮誇的計畫，卻從來沒完成。

ex.en: The hotel lobby has a grandiose staircase.
ex.zh: 這間飯店大廳有一座氣派的樓梯。

ex.en: The old photo was dark and grainy.
ex.zh: 那張舊照片又暗又有顆粒感。

ex.en: This mustard has a grainy texture.
ex.zh: 這種芥末醬有顆粒口感。

ex.en: It was a gripping story that I couldn't put down.
ex.zh: 這是個扣人心弦的故事，我放不下書。

ex.en: The match was so gripping that nobody left their seat.
ex.zh: 比賽太精彩，沒有人離開座位。

ex.en: The child was gripping her mother's hand tightly.
ex.zh: 小女孩緊緊抓著媽媽的手。

ex.en: He walked on, gripping the railing for balance.
ex.zh: 他握著欄杆保持平衡往前走。

ex.en: He still holds a grudge against his old boss.
ex.zh: 他對前老闆仍懷恨在心。

ex.en: Let's forget the past and not bear a grudge.
ex.zh: 讓我們忘掉過去，不要記恨。

ex.en: I don't grudge him his success; he worked hard.
ex.zh: 我不嫉妒他的成功，他很努力。

ex.en: She grudged every penny spent on the repairs.
ex.zh: 她對修理花的每一分錢都捨不得。

ex.en: The gardener will graft a branch onto the apple tree.
ex.zh: 園丁要把一根枝條嫁接到蘋果樹上。

ex.en: Doctors can graft healthy skin onto a burned arm.
ex.zh: 醫生可以把健康的皮膚移植到燒傷的手臂上。

ex.en: The mayor was accused of graft in the building contract.
ex.zh: 市長被指控在工程合約中貪汙。

ex.en: Graft makes people lose trust in the government.
ex.zh: 貪汙會讓人民對政府失去信任。

ex.en: He grudgingly admitted that she was right.
ex.zh: 他勉強承認她是對的。

ex.en: The boy grudgingly cleaned his room.
ex.zh: 那男孩不情願地打掃了房間。

ex.en: The marathon was a grueling test of strength.
ex.zh: 馬拉松是對體力的一場艱苦考驗。

ex.en: After a grueling week, I slept all weekend.
ex.zh: 過完累垮人的一週後，我整個週末都在睡覺。

ex.en: The course gives students a solid grounding in math.
ex.zh: 這門課讓學生打下扎實的數學基礎。

ex.en: A good grounding in grammar helps you write better.
ex.zh: 文法打好基礎有助於寫出更好的文章。

ex.en: He stood there grinning from ear to ear.
ex.zh: 他站在那裡笑得合不攏嘴。

ex.en: The kids were grinning when they opened the box.
ex.zh: 孩子們打開盒子時咧嘴笑了。

ex.en: My grandpa tells great stories about his childhood.
ex.zh: 我爺爺會講很棒的童年故事。

ex.en: We visit Grandpa every Sunday afternoon.
ex.zh: 我們每個週日下午都去看外公。

ex.en: The scientists made a groundbreaking discovery.
ex.zh: 科學家有了開創性的發現。

ex.en: It was a groundbreaking film in its time.
ex.zh: 在當時，這是一部開創先河的電影。

gruelling.zh: 累人的；使人精疲力盡的

ex.en: It was a gruelling climb that took more than ten hours.
ex.zh: 那是一趟超過十小時、令人筋疲力盡的攀登。

ex.en: The team went through a gruelling training schedule before the final.
ex.zh: 決賽前，球隊經歷了一段非常艱苦的訓練。

ex.en: He is always grousing about the weather.
ex.zh: 他總是在抱怨天氣。

ex.en: Stop grousing and help me carry these boxes.
ex.zh: 別再發牢騷了，過來幫我搬這些箱子。

ex.en: My only grouse is that the service was slow.
ex.zh: 我唯一的不滿是服務太慢。

ex.en: The workers had a few grouses about the new schedule.
ex.zh: 員工對新的班表有些牢騷。

greyhound.zh: 靈緹（一種跑得很快的獵犬）

ex.en: The greyhound ran across the field faster than any other dog.
ex.zh: 那隻靈緹跑過田野的速度比任何其他狗都快。

ex.en: A greyhound has a thin body and long legs.
ex.zh: 靈緹有著纖瘦的身體和長腿。

ex.en: The balcony is full of greenery.
ex.zh: 陽台上滿是綠色植物。

ex.en: We enjoyed the fresh greenery in the park after the long winter.
ex.zh: 漫長的冬天過後，我們欣賞著公園裡新生的綠意。

ex.en: The garden soil was full of white grubs.
ex.zh: 花園的土裡有很多白色的幼蟲。

ex.en: Birds dug in the grass to find grubs.
ex.zh: 鳥在草地上挖土尋找幼蟲。

ex.en: Let's get some grub after the game.
ex.zh: 比賽後我們去吃點東西吧。

ex.en: The grub at this camp was surprisingly good.
ex.zh: 這個營地的伙食好得出乎意料。

ex.en: He grubbed around in the drawer for his keys.
ex.zh: 他在抽屜裡東翻西找他的鑰匙。

ex.en: The pigs were grubbing in the mud for roots.
ex.zh: 豬群在泥巴裡拱著找根莖吃。

ex.en: The school is granting scholarships to ten students this year.
ex.zh: 學校今年要頒發獎學金給十名學生。

ex.en: The judge is granting her request for more time.
ex.zh: 法官准許了她延長時間的請求。

ex.en: Granting that he is clever, he still needs to work harder.
ex.zh: 就算他很聰明，還是得更努力。

ex.en: Granting that prices are high, the food is worth it.
ex.zh: 就算價格偏高，這些食物還是值得。

ex.en: The children played among the trees of the greenwood.
ex.zh: 孩子們在綠林的樹木間玩耍。

ex.en: Robin Hood is said to have lived in the greenwood.
ex.zh: 傳說羅賓漢住在綠林之中。

ex.en: He put the cake in a greased pan.
ex.zh: 他把蛋糕麵糊倒進抹了油的烤盤裡。

ex.en: The greased hinges no longer squeaked.
ex.zh: 上過油的鉸鏈不再發出吱吱聲。

ex.en: She graciously accepted the invitation.
ex.zh: 她欣然有禮地接受了邀請。

ex.en: The host graciously welcomed every guest at the door.
ex.zh: 主人在門口親切地迎接每一位客人。

ex.en: A grasshopper jumped onto the leaf.
ex.zh: 一隻蚱蜢跳到葉子上。

ex.en: The children caught a green grasshopper in the field.
ex.zh: 孩子們在田野裡抓到一隻綠色的蚱蜢。

grisly.zh: 令人毛骨悚然的；恐怖的

ex.en: The news told a grisly story of an old crime.
ex.zh: 新聞講了一則關於陳年案件的駭人故事。

ex.en: The movie's grisly scenes made me look away.
ex.zh: 電影裡駭人的畫面讓我別過頭去。

ex.en: His hands were grimy after fixing the engine.
ex.zh: 修完引擎後，他的雙手沾滿汙垢。

ex.en: The grimy window let in very little light.
ex.zh: 那扇髒兮兮的窗戶幾乎透不進光。

ex.en: My grown children live in different cities now.
ex.zh: 我已成年的孩子們現在住在不同的城市。

ex.en: It is hard to see a grown man cry in public.
ex.zh: 看到一個成年男子在公共場合哭泣是很少見的。

grown.zh: 長大；生長（grow 的過去分詞）

ex.en: The tomatoes have grown a lot since last week.
ex.zh: 番茄從上週到現在長了很多。

ex.en: You have grown so tall that I hardly recognized you!
ex.zh: 你長得這麼高，我差點認不出你！

ex.en: A metal grille covered the window of the shop.
ex.zh: 一道金屬柵欄蓋住了商店的窗戶。

ex.en: The car's front grille was damaged in the accident.
ex.zh: 這輛車的前格柵在事故中受損了。

ex.en: The old farmer had a gruff voice but a kind heart.
ex.zh: 那位老農夫聲音粗啞，心地卻很善良。

ex.en: He gave a gruff answer and turned away.
ex.zh: 他粗聲粗氣地回答，然後轉身離開。

ex.en: The machine can granulate plastic into small pieces.
ex.zh: 這台機器能把塑膠研磨成小顆粒。

ex.en: Sugar will granulate if you leave the syrup to dry.
ex.zh: 如果把糖漿放著風乾，糖就會結成顆粒。

ex.en: The water in the pond looked greenish after the rain.
ex.zh: 下雨後，池塘的水看起來有點偏綠。

ex.en: He wore a greenish jacket that matched the trees.
ex.zh: 他穿著一件偏綠色的外套，和樹木很搭。

ex.en: She graduated from college two years ago.
ex.zh: 她兩年前大學畢業。

ex.en: After he graduated, he moved to Hsinchu for work.
ex.zh: 他畢業後搬到新竹工作。

ex.en: Use a graduated cylinder to measure the liquid.
ex.zh: 用量筒來量這個液體。

ex.en: The cup is graduated in milliliters.
ex.zh: 這個杯子上標有毫升刻度。

graded.zh: 評分；打分數（grade 的過去式）

ex.en: The teacher graded our tests over the weekend.
ex.zh: 老師在週末批改了我們的考卷。

ex.en: She graded each essay carefully.
ex.zh: 她仔細地給每篇作文打分數。

ex.en: The course has graded exercises from easy to hard.
ex.zh: 這門課有由易到難的分級練習。

ex.en: The path has a graded slope that is easy for beginners.
ex.zh: 這條步道坡度平緩，適合初學者。

ex.en: The campaign grew from a grassroots movement in small towns.
ex.zh: 這場運動是從小鎮的草根行動發展起來的。

ex.en: Grassroots groups helped clean up the river.
ex.zh: 基層團體協助清理了那條河。

ex.en: My grandkid is learning to ride a bike this summer.
ex.zh: 我的孫子今年夏天正在學騎腳踏車。

ex.en: Grandma keeps a photo of every grandkid in her wallet.
ex.zh: 奶奶的皮夾裡放著每個孫子孫女的照片。

ex.en: The movie has too much gratuitous violence.
ex.zh: 這部電影有太多不必要的暴力情節。

ex.en: His gratuitous remark upset everyone at the table.
ex.zh: 他那句多餘的話讓桌邊的每個人都不高興。

ex.en: We found seats in the grandstand just before the race began.
ex.zh: 我們在比賽開始前找到了看台上的座位。

ex.en: The grandstand was packed with cheering fans.
ex.zh: 看台上擠滿了歡呼的球迷。

ex.en: The grating noise of the machine made my ears hurt.
ex.zh: 機器刺耳的聲音讓我的耳朵很不舒服。

ex.en: I find his grating laugh hard to stand.
ex.zh: 我覺得他那令人煩躁的笑聲很難忍受。

ex.en: A metal grating covered the hole in the street.
ex.zh: 一片金屬格柵蓋住了街上的洞。

ex.en: Light came in through the iron grating above the door.
ex.zh: 光線從門上方的鐵柵照進來。

ex.en: She is a gregarious person who loves meeting new people.
ex.zh: 她是個喜歡結交新朋友、愛交際的人。

ex.en: Our gregarious neighbor invited us to the party.
ex.zh: 我們愛交際的鄰居邀請我們去參加派對。

ex.en: Sheep are gregarious animals that live in flocks.
ex.zh: 綿羊是群居動物，會成群生活。

ex.en: Wolves are gregarious and hunt in packs.
ex.zh: 狼是群居動物，會成群獵食。

ex.en: A grapevine grows along the wall of their garden.
ex.zh: 他們花園的牆邊爬著一株葡萄藤。

ex.en: The grapevine needs to be trimmed every winter.
ex.zh: 葡萄藤每年冬天都需要修剪。

ex.en: I heard through the grapevine that she's moving abroad.
ex.zh: 我從小道消息聽說她要搬到國外。

ex.en: News travels fast on the office grapevine.
ex.zh: 消息在辦公室的小道傳聞中傳得很快。

grumpy.zh: 脾氣暴躁的；愛發牢騷的

ex.en: My dad is always grumpy before he's had his coffee.
ex.zh: 我爸爸在喝咖啡之前總是脾氣很差。

ex.en: The baby was tired and grumpy by the end of the day.
ex.zh: 到了傍晚，寶寶又累又愛鬧脾氣。

ex.en: Stop griping about the weather and put on your coat.
ex.zh: 別再抱怨天氣了，把外套穿上吧。

ex.en: Employees often gripe about the long meetings.
ex.zh: 員工們常常抱怨會議太長。

ex.en: My biggest gripe is that the bus is always late.
ex.zh: 我最大的牢騷就是公車老是晚到。

ex.en: She listed all her gripes about the new schedule.
ex.zh: 她把對新時間表的所有不滿都列了出來。

grimm.zh: 格林（德國的格林兄弟，童話蒐集者）

ex.en: The Brothers Grimm collected folk tales in Germany.
ex.zh: 格林兄弟在德國蒐集民間故事。

ex.en: Many children grow up reading fairy tales by Grimm.
ex.zh: 許多孩子是讀著格林童話長大的。

ex.en: The pirates hid their treasure in a sea grotto.
ex.zh: 海盜把寶藏藏在一個海邊岩洞裡。

ex.en: We cooled off in the shade of a cool grotto.
ex.zh: 我們在涼爽岩洞的陰影下消暑。

ex.en: It gratified him to see his students succeed.
ex.zh: 看到學生成功，他感到很欣慰。

ex.en: The shop tries to gratify every customer's request.
ex.zh: 這家店盡力滿足每位顧客的要求。

ex.en: There was a layer of grime on the kitchen window.
ex.zh: 廚房窗戶上有一層汙垢。

ex.en: He washed the grime off his hands after fixing the bike.
ex.zh: 修完腳踏車後，他把手上的髒汙洗掉。

ex.en: The smoke grimed the walls of the old house.
ex.zh: 煙霧把老房子的牆壁弄髒了。

ex.en: Years of traffic had grimed the statue.
ex.zh: 多年的車流把雕像弄得髒兮兮的。

groupie.zh: 追星族；樂團的狂熱追隨者

ex.en: A group of groupies waited outside the hotel for the band.
ex.zh: 一群追星族在飯店外等著樂團出現。

ex.en: He joked that he was the band's biggest groupie.
ex.zh: 他開玩笑說自己是這個樂團最大的追星族。

ex.en: I felt groggy after waking up so early.
ex.zh: 我這麼早起床，覺得昏昏沉沉的。

ex.en: The medicine made him groggy.
ex.zh: 這個藥讓他頭昏腦脹。

ex.en: He gave a grudging nod of approval.
ex.zh: 他勉強點頭表示同意。

ex.en: She felt a grudging respect for her rival.
ex.zh: 她對對手懷有一絲不甘願的敬意。

ex.en: I had yogurt with granola and berries for breakfast.
ex.zh: 我早餐吃了優格配燕麥脆片和莓果。

ex.en: She packed a granola bar for the hike.
ex.zh: 她為了健行帶了一條燕麥棒。

ex.en: I bought fresh tomatoes from the greengrocer on the corner.
ex.zh: 我在轉角的蔬果店買了新鮮的番茄。

ex.en: The greengrocer arranges the fruit neatly every morning.
ex.zh: 蔬果商每天早上都會把水果擺得整整齊齊。

ex.en: The mask was grotesquely large and covered half his body.
ex.zh: 那個面具大得離譜，遮住了他半個身體。

ex.en: The statue was grotesquely twisted, like a bad dream.
ex.zh: 那座雕像扭曲得很怪誕，像一場惡夢。

ex.en: Granular sugar dissolves quickly in hot tea.
ex.zh: 顆粒狀的糖在熱茶裡很快就溶解了。

ex.en: The soil in the garden is dry and granular.
ex.zh: 花園裡的土壤又乾又呈顆粒狀。

ex.en: The hotel was grandly decorated for the holiday.
ex.zh: 飯店為了節日布置得富麗堂皇。

ex.en: He grandly announced that he would pay for everyone.
ex.zh: 他盛大又誇張地宣布要請大家。

ex.en: My granddaddy tells the best stories at dinner.
ex.zh: 我爺爺在晚餐時講的故事最精彩。

ex.en: We visit granddaddy's farm every summer.
ex.zh: 我們每年夏天都去爺爺的農場。

ex.en: The rumor turned out to be completely groundless.
ex.zh: 那個謠言後來證實完全沒有根據。

ex.en: Your fears are groundless, so please try to relax.
ex.zh: 你的擔心毫無根據，請放輕鬆。

ex.en: She heated the griddle and poured the pancake batter onto it.
ex.zh: 她加熱平底煎鍋，把鬆餅麵糊倒上去。

ex.en: The restaurant cooks burgers on a large griddle.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳用大煎板煎漢堡肉。

ex.en: For many scientists, a cheap clean energy source is the holy grail.
ex.zh: 對許多科學家來說，便宜的潔淨能源是夢寐以求的聖杯。

ex.en: Finding a cure became the grail of his whole career.
ex.zh: 找到治療方法成了他整個職涯夢寐以求的目標。

grasping.zh: 抓住；理解（grasp 的現在分詞）

ex.en: The baby was grasping her finger tightly.
ex.zh: 寶寶緊緊抓著她的手指。

ex.en: He is slowly grasping how the system works.
ex.zh: 他漸漸理解這個系統是怎麼運作的。

ex.en: The grasping landlord raised the rent again.
ex.zh: 那位貪心的房東又調漲了房租。

ex.en: Nobody trusted the grasping businessman.
ex.zh: 沒有人信任那個貪得無厭的商人。

ex.en: I grew up in a small town near the sea.
ex.zh: 我在海邊的小鎮長大。

ex.en: What do you want to be when you grow up?
ex.zh: 你長大後想當什麼？

ex.en: Children grow up so fast these days.
ex.zh: 現在的孩子長得好快。

ex.en: Grow up! You can't always blame others.
ex.zh: 成熟點！你不能老是怪別人。

ex.en: It's time for him to grow up and take responsibility.
ex.zh: 他該成熟一點，負起責任了。

ex.en: Stop acting like a child and grow up.
ex.zh: 別再像個小孩一樣，成熟點吧。
